name: 250910_22h42 Gergueil D104 - Brame
description: Subject : Stag bellowing in Gergueil. Date YMD : 2025 September 10 at 22H42 Location : D104 two hundred meters down the exit of Gergueil - Gergueil 21410 Bourgogne Bourgogne-Franche-Comte Cote-dOr France Hardware : Tascam FR-AV2 in 32bit 192khz. Sennheiser MKE600 with stock windcover. P48, no filter. A manfroto monopod was used. Weather : Processing : Trimmed and normalised in Audacity. Notes : Electric poles were close. So there's a slight buzz :/ Other spots we tried didn't have much activity or too much wind. Tips : Attribution is greatly appreciated but not required. name: Red Deer bugles and roars, Northern Scotland.  Time compressed.  October 1, 2024
description: Recorded October 1, 2024 at 2015 hours from window of Rhiconich Hotel, Rhiconich, Scotland Latitude: 58° 31’ 28” N Longitude 4° 13’ 26” W Red Deer Stags roaring during rutting season. Closest stag approximately 20 meters from recording location along Rhiconich River above Loch Inchard. Distant stags were approximately 1-2 kilometres away. Recorded on Sony M10 with LOM MicroUsi pair, bubblebees, AB stereo, 50 cm separation, 24 bit/96K. The sound of the Rhiconich River was reduced using spectral de-noise in Izotope RX10. Cuts and fades in/out were done in Izotope RX10. The time period of the recording was reduced from 6:51 to 1:46 after cuts to ’silent’ sections. Attribution: Robert Crosley and freesound.org. Thankyou!
